gaps.title: Lack of real‑time temperature monitoring & alerts
gaps.detail: Cold Chain 3PL offers temperature‑sensitive storage and transport but does not mention live IoT tracking, deviation alerts, or automated compliance reporting.
gaps.based_on: Cold Chain 3PL provides storing and transporting temperature‑sensitive products, ensuring proper storage, handling, and product transportation in a temperature‑controlled environment.

gaps.title: Limited real‑time asset and fleet visibility
gaps.detail: While the company moves temperature‑controlled shipments, there is no indication of GPS or sensor‑based tracking for vehicles or high‑value assets, exposing them to potential loss or delays.
gaps.based_on: Cold Chain 3PL provides storing and transporting temperature‑sensitive products, ensuring proper storage, handling, and product transportation in a temperature‑controlled environment.

gaps.title: Manual compliance reporting for regulatory audits
gaps.detail: Cold Chain 3PL lists USDA, SQF, FDA, and Non‑GMO certifications but lacks a digital platform that auto‑generates audit‑ready reports aligned with India’s Schedule M, FSSAI traceability, or WHO‑GDP requirements.
gaps.based_on: Cold Chain 3PL holds certifications including Non‑GMO, USDA, SQF, and FDA.

pitch.angle: Cold Chain 3PL already secures top‑tier certifications and integrates with major eCommerce platforms; adding GND’s ThinxFresh IoT suite would give them live temperature dashboards, instant deviation alerts, and auto‑generated audit reports—turning compliance into a competitive advantage, especially for Indian market regulations.
pitch.opener: I saw Cold Chain 3PL’s USDA and SQF certifications—imagine pairing that credibility with live, sensor‑driven temperature alerts and auto‑audit reports.
